text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly adding to Stock B and later selling at a loss showed me to set a clear buy thesis and price or condition for reassessment before adding.","Avoid reacting to short-term price moves with rapid reversals; check whether new information has actually changed the investment case before trading.","Track returns against a suitable market benchmark over many months, including cash and all holdings, so I can tell whether my decisions are improving long-run performance."]}
